outcome: Activating cycling from hand discards the card as a cost and draws a card on resolution; it cannot be activated from other zones.
A card with cycling still counts as having an activated ability on the battlefield and in other zones.
A 'when you cycle this card' ability triggers when the card is discarded to pay a cycling cost, from whatever zone it ends up in.
A 'cycles or discards' ability triggers once, not twice, when a card is cycled.
Typecycling discards the card as a cost and on resolution searches the library for a matching card, puts it into hand and shuffles.
Typecycling counts as cycling: cycle triggers fire, cycling-prevention effects stop it, and cycling cost modifiers apply.
